tagline.en: Macon to Savannah, the road to the port
tagline.zh: 从梅肯到萨凡纳，通往港口的道路

mileageSource: FHWA Route Log and Finder List, Table 1, January 2026

start.zh: 佐治亚州梅肯，与 I-75 相接

end.en: Montgomery Street in downtown Savannah, Georgia
end.zh: 佐治亚州萨凡纳市中心，蒙哥马利街

en: I-16 runs from the middle of Georgia to the coast and does nothing else. It never leaves the state, it meets no other two-digit Interstate except at its two ends, and between Macon and Savannah it passes through no city at all — Dublin, the largest place near the middle, sits a couple of miles off the road. It is one of only thirteen two-digit Interstates that are both continuous and wholly within one state.

The land it crosses is coastal plain: pine plantations, pecan and peanut country, timber, and to the north of the corridor one of the world's largest deposits of kaolin clay. Traffic drops away sharply once past the Macon suburbs, picks up slightly around Dublin, and thins again before building towards Savannah.

Its eastern end is unusual for an Interstate. Rather than joining another freeway, I-16 runs into downtown Savannah on an elevated spur and stops at a city street, having cut through several residential blocks to get there. Alternatives for removing that last stretch and replacing it with a boulevard have been under study for years.
zh: I-16 自佐治亚中部通往海岸，别无其他。它从不离开本州，除两端外不与任何其他两位数州际公路相交，而在梅肯与萨凡纳之间它根本不穿过任何城市——中段附近最大的聚落都柏林也位于路外几英里处。它是仅有的十三条既连续、又完全位于单一州内的两位数州际公路之一。
它穿越的是海岸平原：松树人工林、山核桃与花生产区、木材产地，而走廊以北还有世界上最大的高岭土矿藏之一。车流量在越过梅肯郊区后骤降，在都柏林一带略有回升，随后再次稀薄，直到接近萨凡纳才逐渐攀升。
它的东端对一条州际公路而言颇为反常。I-16 并未与另一条高速相接，而是以一段高架支线驶入萨凡纳市中心，终止于一条城市街道——为此它切穿了数个住宅街区。多年来一直有方案在研究，拟拆除这最后一段并以林荫大道取而代之。

en: I-16 opened in sections over twelve years. Construction on the first segment, sixteen miles in Laurens and Treutlen counties, began in March 1963 and it opened on 11 October 1966. The easternmost stretch into the Savannah area followed in November 1967, and the Macon end was finished in 1968; most of the middle was built through the 1970s.

Georgia accelerated the work with an unusual financing move: the state issued bond revenue to complete the road and was later reimbursed for the principal out of the federal Highway Trust Fund, rather than waiting on annual federal apportionments.

The final section — 25.5 miles across Emanuel, Candler and Bulloch counties — opened on 22 September 1978. It is officially the James Gillis, Sr. Memorial Highway, after a long-serving director of the Georgia Highway Department; in 2003 the legislature separately renamed the part east of I-95 the Jim Gillis Historic Savannah Parkway, explicitly to help the city's tourist traffic find its way in.
zh: I-16 在十二年间分段通车。第一段位于劳伦斯县与特鲁特伦县，全长十六英里，1963 年 3 月动工，1966 年 10 月 11 日通车。通往萨凡纳一带的最东段于 1967 年 11 月跟进，梅肯一端于 1968 年完工；中段的大部分建于 1970 年代。
佐治亚以一种不寻常的融资手段加快了进度：州政府发行债券筹资完成道路建设，本金随后由联邦公路信托基金偿还，而不是等待联邦逐年拨款。
最后一段——横跨伊曼纽尔、坎德勒与布洛克三县的 25.5 英里——于 1978 年 9 月 22 日通车。这条路的正式名称是詹姆斯·吉利斯（老）纪念公路，以纪念长期主政佐治亚公路局的那位局长；2003 年，州议会又单独将 I-95 以东的路段改名为吉姆·吉利斯历史萨凡纳景观道，其明确目的就是帮助前往该市的游客找到方向。

en: I-16 exists to move goods off the Georgia coast. When the road was nearing completion in 1978, Governor George Busbee said its economic importance lay in linking the coast with the rest of the state and in the movement of goods from the Port of Savannah — and the port's growth since then has been the dominant fact in the corridor's traffic history.

Almost all of the port's container traffic is handled at Garden City Terminal, about six miles from both I-16 and I-95, and container throughput grew several times faster than the national rate over the two decades after 1980. Dublin, roughly midway between Savannah and Atlanta and with much cheaper land than either, acquired two large retail distribution centres in the early 2000s specifically because of its proximity to the road.

The count pattern tells the same story from the other direction. Traffic is heaviest immediately east of the I-75 junction in Macon and in the Savannah area, with a minor peak at Dublin and the lightest volumes in rural Treutlen County — a freight route with two urban ends and not much in between.
zh: I-16 的存在是为了把货物从佐治亚海岸运出去。1978 年这条路接近完工时，州长乔治·巴斯比曾表示，它的经济意义在于把海岸与全州其余地区连接起来，以及在于萨凡纳港的货物运输——此后港口的成长，正是这条走廊交通史上的主导事实。
港口的集装箱运输几乎全部在花园城码头处理，该码头距 I-16 与 I-95 均约六英里；1980 年之后的二十年间，其集装箱吞吐量增速是全国平均水平的数倍。位于萨凡纳与亚特兰大之间、地价远低于两者的都柏林，在 2000 年代初期正是因为紧邻这条公路而引入了两座大型零售配送中心。
交通量的分布从另一个方向讲述了同样的故事。车流最密集处是梅肯 I-75 枢纽以东和萨凡纳一带，都柏林有一处小高峰，最稀疏的则是乡村的特鲁特伦县——一条两端是城市、中间乏善可陈的货运路线。

value.en: $174.0 million, all in Georgia. State and federal funds combined, in dollars of the day, as tabulated by FHWA at the close of the Interstate Construction programme; it excludes reconstruction after 1989.
value.zh: 1.740 亿美元，全部在佐治亚。州与联邦资金合计，按当年美元计，为联邦公路管理局在州际建设计划收尾时的统计口径；不含 1989 年以后的改建。

figures.source: FHWA, Interstate System engineering data, Part III – Cost: estimated cost of individual Interstate routes, 1991 Interstate Cost Estimate (data as of 31 December 1989)

value.zh: 165.71 英里，全线位于佐治亚州境内

figures.source: FHWA Route Log and Finder List, Table 1, January 2026

label.en: Industrial investment attributed to the road
label.zh: 归因于这条公路的工业投资

value.en: A $1 billion paper mill was built near Rincon in Effingham County in the mid-1980s, a decision a company spokesman attributed in part to I-16 access
value.zh: 1980 年代中期，埃芬厄姆县林孔附近建成一座造价 10 亿美元的纸厂；公司发言人称这一决策部分归因于可通过 I-16 通达

figures.source: FHWA, Economic Development History of Interstate 16 in Georgia, 2003–2004

label.zh: 梅肯 I-16 与 I-75 立交改建

value.en: Georgia DOT calls it a $500 million megaproject delivered in seven phases; work began in 2017, the bulk is expected to finish in 2027 and a final phase in 2030. ARTBA puts the current estimate at $682 million, of which $572 million is federal
value.zh: 佐治亚州交通部称其为分七期实施的 5 亿美元特大项目；2017 年动工，主体预计 2027 年完工，最后一期 2030 年完工。美国道路与运输建设者协会给出的最新估算为 6.82 亿美元，其中 5.72 亿美元为联邦资金

figures.source: Georgia DOT project description via Dixie Contractor; The Atlanta Journal-Constitution, September 2025; ARTBA project profile, May 2025

label.en: Busiest point, east of the I-75 junction in Macon
label.zh: 最繁忙处：梅肯 I-75 枢纽以东

value.en: Annual average daily traffic has fluctuated around 70,000 since 1990
value.zh: 自 1990 年以来，年平均日交通量在 70,000 辆左右波动

trafficFigures.source: FHWA, Economic Development History of Interstate 16 in Georgia, 2003–2004

value.en: Nearly 14,000 vehicles a day on the segment west of Exit 71 in 2003
value.zh: 2003 年，71 号出口以西路段日均近 14,000 辆车

trafficFigures.source: FHWA, Economic Development History of Interstate 16 in Georgia, 2003–2004

label.zh: 萨凡纳港集装箱吞吐量

value.en: 1.5 million twenty-foot equivalent units in 2003, seven times the 201,000 handled in 1980; national container traffic merely quadrupled over the same period
value.zh: 2003 年为 150 万标准箱，是 1980 年 201,000 标准箱的七倍；同期全国集装箱运量仅增长四倍

trafficFigures.source: FHWA, Economic Development History of Interstate 16 in Georgia, 2003–2004

label.en: Structures rebuilt at the Macon interchange
label.zh: 梅肯立交改建中的结构物

value.en: 11 bridges upgraded, plus new collector–distributor lanes, additional interstate lanes, new ramps, retaining walls and drainage
value.zh: 改造桥梁 11 座，并新增集散车道、州际公路车道、匝道、挡土墙与排水设施

conditionFigures.source: Georgia DOT, I-16/I-75 Interchange Improvements Project description

timeline.en: Construction begins on the first 16 miles, in Laurens and Treutlen counties.
timeline.zh: 首段 16 英里工程在劳伦斯县与特鲁特伦县动工。

timeline.en: The first segment opens to traffic on 11 October.
timeline.zh: 首段于 10 月 11 日通车。

timeline.en: The easternmost 28 miles open in the Savannah area on 24 November.
timeline.zh: 萨凡纳一带最东端 28 英里于 11 月 24 日通车。

timeline.en: The route is finished in the Macon area.
The final 25.5 miles open on 22 September, completing the route.
timeline.zh: 最后 25.5 英里于 9 月 22 日通车，全线贯通。

timeline.en: For Hurricane Floyd, the eastbound lanes from Savannah to US 1 are opened to westbound traffic — the first contraflow evacuation on this route.
timeline.zh: 为应对飓风弗洛伊德，自萨凡纳至 US 1 的东行车道开放给西行车辆——这是本路线首次实施逆向疏散。

timeline.en: Georgia DOT installs drop-gate barricades at every interchange on the 115 miles between Dublin and Savannah to make contraflow routine.
timeline.zh: 佐治亚州交通部在都柏林至萨凡纳 115 英里区间的每处立交安装落杆式路障，使逆向通行常态化。

timeline.en: The legislature renames I-16 east of I-95 the Jim Gillis Historic Savannah Parkway.
timeline.zh: 州议会将 I-95 以东的 I-16 改名为吉姆·吉利斯历史萨凡纳景观道。

timeline.en: Work begins on the reconstruction of the I-16 / I-75 interchange in Macon.
timeline.zh: 梅肯 I-16 与 I-75 立交改建工程动工。
